title: Schedules
hint: A schedule opens a new session in its project and sends it the prompt at the set time. Schedules only run while Puppeteer is open; slots missed while it was closed run once when it opens again.
remote: From a remote desktop you can create and edit schedules, but only someone at this machine can switch one on. Saving here switches the schedule off.
empty: No schedules yet. Create one, or ask an agent in a session to propose one.
proposedHint: Open it, review it and save it before it can be switched on.
deleteMessage: "{name}" stops running. Sessions it already opened are kept.
saveHint: A new schedule starts off: switch it on in the list.
remoteSave: Saving from a remote desktop switches the schedule off.

modeHint.plan: The agent can read and think, but not edit files or run commands.
modeHint.auto: The agent decides each call; one it cannot approve on its own is declined instead of asked, so the next runs go on.
modeHint.default: A tool that needs approval waits until someone answers; the next runs are skipped meanwhile.
modeHint.acceptEdits: The agent edits files without asking. Nobody is watching a scheduled run.
modeHint.bypassPermissions: The agent does anything without asking. Nobody is watching a scheduled run.

formError.name: Enter a name (up to 200 characters).
formError.every_minutes: Minutes must be a whole number from 1 to 10080 (a week).
